# Executions
Executions may be sanctioned only by a Commanding Officer, the XO, or an Acting Commanding Officer are not permitted to sanction executions. The Commanding Officer holds the right to sanction executions on members of the military who they deem that their life and existence is a threat to their unit and operation.
Commanding Officer ordered executions must be upheld and followed through with, the Commanding Officer may permit members of the military police to carry out executions. Commanding Officer ordered executions do not offer any chance of appeal or alternative punishment, if the Commanding Officer has ordered it, it must be fulfilled.
Crimninals charged with a capital offense and are ordered to be executed by a Commanding Officer must be given a chance to return to the ship/installation, in the event they refuse a execution can be done in the field by any military member. Criminals to be executed must be permitted a final meal of choice within reason and given chance to pray if they are religious, after which they must be given the option of firing squad or lethal injection.
Firing squads consist of atleast two members at minimum, with one member minimum being a military police member. Lethal Injection consists of one trained medical professional such as a Doctor or Nurse, administering a fatal overdose of chemicals.
After a execution has been performed it is required to have a report sent to the provost offices, the report should list: - Personnel executed - Crime - Last meal - Execution methods - Name and rank of the personnel who permitted the execution - any relevant information
[italic]OOC Note: Executions are a round removal tool only to be utilized by HRP Whitelisted Commanding Officers as a last resort means to put a end to users who have commited egregious actions and will likely continue to do so. It is a power normally only granted to administrators to perform and such should not be violated. Explotiing executions for personal gain or metagruding reasons will result in admin intervention and punishment. [/italaic]
